title: The Length of the PDF stream refers to the number of bytes of the encoded data
summary: The Length field defines the stream data carried in the file, and the length may change after applying Filter decoding.
detail: Lengths may be given via indirect objects; newlines and stream/endstream keywords should not be fully included in the data.
boundary: Endstream byte strings may happen to appear in compressed data, and simply searching for keywords is not a reliable binary boundary.
relevance: Distinguish between compressed length and decoded length when extracting images or text streams from documents.
